title: DeepCool PN650M 650W 80 Plus Gold Full-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
DeepCool PN650M 650W Power Supply, designed for next-gen hardware, high efficiency, and clean cable management. With 80 PLUS Gold certification, this PSU delivers up to 90% efficiency, reducing energy waste and keeping your system cool and stable under heavy loads.

Built to meet the latest ATX 3.1 and PCIe 5.0 standards, the PN650M includes a native 12VHPWR cable, ensuring full compatibility with NVIDIA RTX 40 series GPUs. Its full-modular design gives users complete control over cable configuration, improving airflow and reducing clutter.

Engineered with premium components and a 120mm Fluid Dynamic Bearing (FDB) fan, the PN650M ensures quiet operation, long-term durability, and rock-solid power delivery.


The DeepCool PN650M 650W 80 Plus Gold Full-Modular ATX 3.1 Power Supply is a premium, future-ready PSU designed for gaming PCs, creative workstations, and powerful productivity systems. Featuring the newest ATX 3.1 standard, this power supply supports next-generation graphics cards with its native 12V-2×6 (16-pin) PCIe connector, ensuring stable and clean power delivery for high-end GPUs.


With 80 Plus Gold efficiency, the PN650M maintains excellent power performance with minimal energy loss and reduced heat output. Its advanced Full Bridge LLC + DC-to-DC topology guarantees precise voltage regulation and consistent output, even under heavy load.


The fully modular cable design allows users to connect only the cables they need, reducing clutter and improving airflow, making it perfect for clean and optimized PC builds. A quiet 120mm Hydro Bearing fan ensures efficient and low-noise cooling.


Built with multiple protection features including OVP, OCP, OPP, UVP, SCP, and OTP, the PN650M ensures maximum safety for your components. Backed by a 10-year warranty, it stands as a highly reliable and long-lasting power solution for PC builders in Bangladesh.
